corpus_rule: append-only: each batch's rows follow the earlier batches' rows unchanged; one row per pair across all batches

lambda-2026-10-07.corpus_row_rule: one row per pair: {entry_id, target_id, verdict, rater, batch} with rater "majority" and batch "lambda-2026-10-07", plus reason (the chosen word's rater's reason) and raters (every vote: seat, verdict, reason)
lambda-2026-10-07.n_pairs_rule: every (entry_id, target_id) in fused-memory/calibration/write_triage_pairs_to_rate.jsonl; none is in ι seed (asserted)
lambda-2026-10-07.majority_rule: Per pair, votes are primary (p seat), second (s seat) and, when consulted, third (t) and fourth (u). The resolution is score_write_triage_pairs.py::resolve_verdicts over all of the pair's votes (strict majority on belongs-vs-misfile, then on CORRECTS-vs-not, UNCLEAR abstaining). The word written is: (1) when no third rater was consulted, the primary word (first two agree on both binaries and neither is UNCLEAR; same rule as data/write-triage-stronger-models-2026-09-30/score_models.py::truth_l2); (2) otherwise the word cast by >= 2 raters if that word is consistent with the resolution; else the third rater's word if consistent; else the first consistent word in the order fourth, primary, second. Asserted: resolve_verdicts over the single written row equals the resolution over all votes for every pair, and no pair is TIED.
lambda-2026-10-07.verdict_counts_rule: written (majority) word per pair, over all 1,216 pairs
lambda-2026-10-07.word_source_counts_rule: which rater's word was written, per majority_rule

kappa.rule: Cohen kappa (each rater's own marginals) between the primary and second rater, over the pairs where neither said UNCLEAR; anchors excluded; same formula as data/write-triage-stronger-models-2026-09-30/make_third.py::kappa

lambda-2026-10-07.three_rater_disputes_rule: pairs where primary and second differ on CORRECTS-vs-not or belongs-vs-misfile, or either said UNCLEAR; each got a third Opus high-effort rater
lambda-2026-10-07.dispute_kinds_rule: primary/second word pair over the three-rater disputes
lambda-2026-10-07.third_rater_binary_side_rule: over disputes where primary and second differ on a binary (UNCLEAR-only disputes excluded): whose binaries the third rater matched
lambda-2026-10-07.fourth_rater_pairs_rule: pairs still TIED by resolve_verdicts after three votes (a third-rater UNCLEAR on a split pair); each got a fourth Opus high-effort rater

anchor_agreement.contested_anchors_rule: anchor pairs where at most half of this session's ratings agree with the seed verdict on belongs-vs-misfile or on CORRECTS-vs-not; the seed is one rater per pair, so these are pairs on which the seed rating itself is in question, not evidence of batch drift

lambda-2026-10-07.anchor_agreement_rule: each anchor rating vs that pair's single verdict in ι seed fused-memory/tests/fixtures/write_triage_pair_verdicts_seed.jsonl; binary agreement counted over ratings that are not UNCLEAR (n_decided); every seat got 10 anchors: 3 prior RELATED, 2 prior CORRECTS, 5 prior SAME/EXTENDS/SUBSUMED
lambda-2026-10-07.shard_sizes_rule: items per seat = pairs + anchors; every seat <= 55 items with 10 anchors; primary and second rounds are independent shuffles into 28 shards each
